findings.finding: The VISUAL_COMPARE obligation is the only obligation in the plan that can pin the frame width to the frozen 402, but the observer that executes it is not independent of the subject under test. Before measuring, it reads a numeric constant exported by the delivered Screen.js (`subject.__figmaWidthDelta`) and mutates the frame with it, then re-reads getBoundingClientRect. An implementation that renders a non-conforming width (e.g. 400px) and exports a compensating delta of 2 is reported as width 402 and passes. This directly contradicts the justification carried into every change intent of this plan item, which states the trusted browser 'checks the reference without reading numeric return constants'. The driver uses the same hook deliberately in the inflating direction to demonstrate rejection (qualify-vnext-figma-real-path.js:108), which confirms the hook is live; nothing in the plan forbids the subject from using it in the compensating direction, and src/features/example/Screen.js is inside write_scope.

findings.finding: Neither geometry assertion is discriminating as planned. The browser observation is run with device metrics whose width is taken from the assertion's own viewport (402) and whose height is taken from the expected height rule value (874), so the emulated viewport equals the expected frame box. A viewport-relative implementation (width:100%, height:100vh) measures exactly 402x874 and satisfies both EQUALS rules at tolerance 0 without ever realizing the fixed 402pt/874pt reference. The FUNCTIONAL_TEST side cannot compensate, because its expected text only requires the width/height CSS declarations to be 'present'. The retained screenshot is likewise non-discriminating: it is captured with captureBeyondViewport:false at the same metrics. Height in particular has no oracle anywhere in the plan that is independent of the viewport chosen to measure it.

findings.required_correction: Make the geometry criterion discriminating: require the Node obligation to assert the exact declared values (frame width:402px and height:874px in the rendered markup), and/or require the VISUAL_COMPARE observation to be taken with a device height different from the expected 874 so that a viewport-relative frame cannot satisfy the height assertion.

findings.finding: The expected text of this test obligation requires only presence, not equality: 'the frame and title data-figma-id locators, width/height CSS declarations and title text are present'. A render() emitting data-figma-id="4478:7209" with width:1px;height:1px satisfies it literally. No Node-executed obligation in the plan therefore pins the frozen 402/874 values, which leaves the geometry entirely dependent on the VISUAL_COMPARE route weakened by the two preceding findings. (The 'Zones corporelles' content assertion is not affected in the same way: textContent is compared exactly by the observer with no subject-controlled adjustment, so the identical wording in TEST-d437f04e0b6969ae349c2b0e is backed elsewhere.)
